notes.title: PROPHAN ESCAPE UPDATES!
notes.notes:
Prophan Escape will be released in the summer, but for now you can enjoy the game demo!
We're working on the final boss of the game which will feature completely new enemies, mechanics, and atmosphere. We can not reveal many details about it, but  be sure it will be great to fight against this gigant monster (uh... wait... that's a detail...).

We are also adding more stuff to previous levels, such as easter eggs, a new mechanic for getting the statues, pieces of the lore spreaded all around the map, and even whole secret rooms to discover!

We can't wait to bring you this game! For now you can follow us on all our social media as Desertical Studio so you don't lose any updates, just like this artwork by [url=https://twitter.com/El_Pesado25]ElPesadoDeTurno[/url]!

notes.title: NEW TEASER TRAILER!
notes.notes:
We have published the second Prophan Escape Steam Teaser Trailer, which shows two of the levels that will come in the final version. We hope you like this trailer!

[previewyoutube=b4cgDzy9w9E;full][/previewyoutube]

This trailer reveals two of the new levels of the final version (Level 3 and 4) and some ajustements of previous levels. We won't update the DEMO because we preffer to launch all the changes in one single version.

The Level 3 ("RUN") is inspired by the Backrooms "Level !", in which you have to RUN FOR YOUR LIFE AND NEVER LOOK BACK. This level takes place in a hospital full of red lights.

The other one ("THE SEWERS"), as its name says, takes place in the sewers. In this level you will have a flashlight which will help you finding youn way in that wet and dark labyrinth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733474/2d37a5b331f8226907e17ba357d79cb832674631.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733474/542d8007b05a0814007427077a70afa5de9050b6.png[/img]

We are really excited about the release of Prophan Escape an we will do everything we can to finish it as soon as possible. But for now, you can play the DEMO and wishlist the game if you don't want to lose anything.

Bye!

notes.title: ¡PROPHAN ESCAPE DEMO IS HERE!
notes.notes: Today at 17:00h (Spanish time) the demo of this horror game will finally be released. Add it as soon as possible to your wish list and be one of the first to try it.
